page.content:
First woman, fashioned as Zeus's answer to stolen fire.

How Pandora connects

  • Character: Zeus — Zeus ordered Pandora made as the price of stolen fire.
  • Character: Hephaestus — Hephaestus fashioned Pandora from earth.

What is Pandora?

Pandora was made by Hephaestus and gifted by the gods; her jar released evils into the mortal world, leaving hope inside — Zeus's counterstroke after Prometheus.

Key threads lead to Zeus and Hephaestus.
